regime_context: The detector is in a semiconductor-led 'everything AI-infra' regime with eligible breadth narrowing (20/49 eligible, 0.41 breadth_of_rotation, absorption 0.31, one_narrative=false). Momentum rank is rank-IC ~0 (attention lens only); the validated edge is the absolute-trend gate (gate_helps=true), so I lean only where trend-health/durability concur. Track record shows dir_accuracy 0.488 with n=84 — recent direction calls were coin-flip, so I default all convictions low.
emerging_watch: Watch whether the leader's 'val_state: fading' tag follows through into a durability_bar drop below 0.6 while Memory/HBM's r10 overtakes AI Infrastructure's r10 — that handoff (not a pre-announced one) would be the observably confirmed rotation signal; until then treat the top-2 as the single eligible AI-infra block.

theses.subject: AI Infrastructure
theses.thesis: Leader with top momentum score (2.295), eligible under the absolute-trend gate, high breadth (0.875) and durability_bar 0.71 with no crowding flag. The trend-gate leg is the only validated edge here; the rank itself is attention, so I lean with the eligible trend rather than against it — but the 'val_state: fading' on the headline and mixed hurst_tag keep conviction modest.
theses.dissent: Headline shows val_state 'fading'; a mixed hurst_tag means the trend is not strongly persistent, and cross-sectional rank has no forward return edge, so leadership can rotate without warning.

falsifier.text: SMH closes below its 50-day moving average while breadth weakens below 0.5 before the check-by date

theses.subject: Memory, HBM & Storage
theses.thesis: Challenger (score 1.873) is eligible, has a 'trend' hurst_tag (persistent) with durability_bar 0.72, and is not crowded. It is the closest rival to the leader and the rotation margin (0.422) is narrow enough that it need not be a binary fade — the trend discipline supports holding the eligible trend leg.
theses.dissent: Its ETF proxy is SMH, the same as AI Infra — so the 'Memory/HBM' leg is not independently tradeable via the given proxy and could just be beta to the same basket rather than a distinct trend.

falsifier.text: SMH relative to SPY turns negative on a 10-day return basis while the theme's r10 rank drops below that of the leader's before the check-by date

theses.subject: Cybersecurity
theses.thesis: Eligible and a clean trend (hurst_tag='trend', breadth 1.0) but crowding_z=1.97 marks it crowded=true — the guardrails say never fade on a crowding flag, but crowding is a size-DOWN caution. I would not add here; any lean is capped, not shorted.
theses.dissent: Perfect breadth and a persistent trend are usually continuation-friendly; crowding alone has no basket-level forward edge and may simply reflect strong flow that keeps working.

falsifier.text: CIBR's relative strength vs SPY holds above its trailing 20-day average while breadth stays near 1.0, showing the crowding flag did not precede any shake-out

macro_narrative.note: market-level macro/policy/geo narrative flow; coincident, not per-theme, never a trigger
